protocol:
1. A liquid is transferred using a micropipette into a 96-well plate held in a blue rack. Reagents are kept in microcentrifuge tubes on ice in a green bucket.
2. The 96-well plate, held in a green rack, is carried from the preparation bench to a Bio-Rad T100 Thermal Cycler.
3. The lid of the thermal cycler is opened and the 96-well plate is placed into the thermal block.
4. The lid of the thermal cycler is closed.
5. A thermal cycling program is selected and started using the touchscreen interface of the Bio-Rad T100 Thermal Cycler.
